scope: Fixed-version primary arXiv abstract pages and citation metadata, fetched at the recorded times; linked repositories only where noted. No full-paper reading (except where a check names it), model execution, data download or reproduction is claimed.

primary_checks.title: TypedBench: A Benchmark for Calibration, Framing Sensitivity, and Cost in System One Decision Models
primary_checks.limitations: Fixed-v2 abstract only. Items come from seven synthetic policy-labelled generators, the abstract does not name the hosted model or its version, and no code or data release is linked. No experiment was reproduced.

primary_checks.title: Does a Hosted Decision Model Respect Irrelevant Alternatives? A Pre-Registered Test of Option-Set Dependence in Jev
primary_checks.limitations: Fixed-v1 abstract only. One pinned model version and three intent and topic classification datasets; no code or call records are linked. No experiment was reproduced.

primary_checks.title: Nudge the Judge: Uncovering Program Decision Hijacking in Real-World Jev Applications
primary_checks.limitations: Fixed-v1 abstract plus the linked repository's README and file list; nothing was executed. Impact is potential rather than demonstrated exploitation, applications were chosen by popularity, and maintainer responses to the disclosure were pending. The released benchmark manifest and README describe the 2,273 records as a flips-first selection capped at ten per project, so the 81.5% and 98.6% rates describe that curated subset, not an unbiased estimate.

primary_checks.title: From Detection to Decision: Calibration and Deferral for Prompt-Injection Detection
primary_checks.limitations: Fixed-v1 abstract only. The abstract does not state the Jev version, and no data or code release is linked. No experiment was reproduced.

primary_checks.title: How Reliable Are System-One Decisions in Medicine? A Comparative Study of Jev, Jev-like Models, and LLMs
primary_checks.limitations: Fixed-v1 abstract only. Benchmark questions, not patient care or prospective clinical validation; no code or data release is linked. No experiment was reproduced.

primary_checks.title: Jev-ToM: Evaluating Theory of Mind in Typed Decision Models
primary_checks.limitations: Fixed-v1 abstract plus the linked repository's README, license note and file list; nothing was executed. English text only, and the README says model selection followed evaluation. Author material is CC BY 4.0; source benchmarks keep their own, partly noncommercial, terms.
